pages.title: Project Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to Windows 7 Clicker Remastered — what it is, how to run it, and how the repository is organized. Links to child pages for setup and gameplay concepts.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Step-by-step guide for running the game from source (Python + pgzero) and as a compiled executable. Covers dependencies, directory layout, and the dev-build watermark.

page_notes.content: The button assets are yet to be replaced as said in the dev watermark

pages.title: Gameplay Mechanics
pages.purpose: Explains the core clicker loop: clicking the Windows logo, earning currency, critical hits, particle effects, and the three upgrade items (Auto Clicker, Super Clicker, Multi Click).

pages.title: Source Code Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of main.py's internal structure — the pgzero lifecycle hooks, global state variables, and how the game loop ties together input, update, and draw. Links to child pages for each major subsystem.

pages.title: Game Loop and State Management
pages.purpose: Deep dive into the pgzrun/pgzero event loop, the update() and draw() functions, global variables (count, click_value, bonus flags), and the clock.schedule_interval auto-clicker timers.

pages.title: Input Handling and Click Pipeline
pages.purpose: Details the on_mouse_down() handler, the aplicar_click() critical-hit logic (10% chance, 5× multiplier), collision detection with Actors, and the bounce animation triggered on each click.

page_notes.content: The button assets are yet to be replaced as said in the dev watermark

pages.title: Upgrade System
pages.purpose: Covers the three purchasable upgrades: Bonus 1 (Auto Clicker, +1/2 s), Bonus 2 (Super Clicker, +15/2 s), and Bonus 3 (Multi Click, +1 click_value). Explains pricing, ownership counters, and the draw_bonus() UI helper.

page_notes.content: The button assets are yet to be replaced as said in the dev watermark

pages.title: Assets
pages.purpose: Overview of all non-code resources bundled with the game — images, audio, fonts, and the application icon. Links to child pages for visual and audio assets.

page_notes.content: The button assets are yet to be replaced as said in the dev watermark

pages.title: Visual Assets
pages.purpose: Documents every image file in images/: background.png (desktop backdrop), windows.png (the clickable Windows logo actor), bonus.png (upgrade shop icons), backoldbackup.png (legacy backup of the original background), and win7.ico (executable icon).

page_notes.content: The button assets are yet to be replaced as said in the dev watermark (bonus.png)

pages.title: Audio Assets
pages.purpose: Documents the music and sounds directories: bgwin7 (looping background track), win7intro (startup jingle played once), win7 (per-click sound effect), and win7battery (purchase confirmation sound). Explains how pgzero's music and sounds namespaces load these files.

pages.title: Build and Distribution
pages.purpose: Overview of how the game is packaged into a standalone Windows executable using PyInstaller. Links to child pages covering the build spec and the PyInstaller runtime internals.

pages.title: PyInstaller Build Spec and TOC
pages.purpose: Explains main.spec (Analysis, PYZ, EXE blocks), the asset datas mappings, UPX compression, the win7.ico icon setting, and what the generated Analysis-00.toc and EXE-00.toc files record about bundled binaries and data files.

pages.title: PyInstaller Runtime Internals
pages.purpose: Covers the frozen-application bootstrap machinery bundled in build/main/localpycs/: ZlibArchiveReader (pyimod01_archive), PyiFrozenFinder/Loader (pyimod02_importers), ctypes library redirection (pyimod03_ctypes), pywin32 DLL bootstrapping (pyimod04_pywin32), the struct helper, and base_library.zip.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Definitions of every codebase-specific term, framework concept, and abbreviation an onboarding engineer needs to know, with code pointers to the relevant files and symbols.
